description: CapacityExpansion, published by YoungFaithful, formulates generation and transmission capacity-expansion problems with investment and dispatch decisions in Julia. Coverage: The package supplies California and German examples with aggregate regions, hourly temporal resolution and DC optimal power flow. The framework is configurable beyond those examples. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is MIT. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: Numerical correctness and compatibility have not been independently tested. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning, optimisation studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
